paragraphs: Scouting PASS is a web page displayed in a browser. It consists of 5 "swipeable" pages, each representing a specific aspect of a FRC match: Pre-Match, Autonomous, Teleop, End Game, and Post-Match. A configuration file allows the screens to be easily modified to collect any metrics that are important for your scouting needs. The scouter can use the "Next" or "Prev" buttons or a swiping motion on touchscreens to move between pages. A QR code is dynamically generated on the last page. This QR code can be scanned to transfer the data to your data repository. The QR code can also be stored for…
Configuration is as easy as creating a JSON file with the fields that your scouting team wants to track. Some fields are common to all teams and years. The basic fields are:
User-defined fields can be of several different types:
features: Works on any device that has a web browser that runs JavaScript. Apple, Android, phones, tablets, laptops, it works on them all.
Scouter - who is scouting this robot
Event - the event that is being scouted
Level - The level of competition (Qualifications, Double Elimination, Finals, etc)
Match - the match number that is being scouted
